🧠 Crypto News Brief: Bitcoin is clinging to its best September on record even as Treasury yields hit multi-decade highs. Meanwhile, Wall Street keeps building on-chain rails while US regulators run on a skeleton crew. 📈 Bitcoin Eyes Best September on Record as Bond Yields Bite Bitcoin is up about 7.3% in September, fractionally ahead of 2024's 7.29% and on course for its best September since 2013, provided it closes the month above roughly $83,600. The push comes despite a bond-market selloff that drove the US 10-year Treasury yield to its highest level since 2007, while spot Bitcoin ETFs extended their inflow streak to nine straight sessions. Read full story 🛡️ Bitget Restores USDT Withdrawals After $387M Hack Bitget has reopened BTC, ETH and USDT withdrawals following its $387.5 million breach, with fiat, P2P and remaining tokens scheduled to return Friday. Its first post-hack proof-of-reserves snapshot shows all 19 covered assets above 100%, and CEO Gracy Chen says the User Protection Fund is back above $300 million. More details ⚖️ SEC and CFTC Shrink to Three Commissioners as Peirce Exits Hester Peirce, the SEC's "Crypto Mom," leaves the agency on Friday, leaving Chair Paul Atkins and Mark Uyeda as its only commissioners. With Michael Selig running the CFTC alone, just three officials will steer US crypto oversight across both regulators, as the White House says nominations are coming soon. Read more 🏛️ Cboe and S&P Dow Jones Eye Tokenized S&P 500 Options Cboe Global Markets and S&P Dow Jones Indices renewed their exclusive S&P 500 options licence for another 25 years, through 2051, and flagged possible collaboration on tokenized options contracts. The idea is still exploratory, but it links a franchise that traded a record 970.6 million contracts in 2025 to blockchain infrastructure. See details 🏦 Morgan Stanley Opens Digital Asset Lab for Stablecoins and DeFi Morgan Stanley has set up a Digital Asset Lab within its innovation-lab network to test stablecoins, tokenized deposits, CBDCs, tokenized money-market funds and DeFi vaults, isolated from its core banking systems. The effort, led by Megan Brewer, does not yet give clients access to any of these products. Full report 🇭🇰 HSBC Names Its Hong Kong Dollar Stablecoin "RedCoin" Hong Kong's largest bank has branded its upcoming HKD-pegged stablecoin HSBC RedCoin and plans to roll it out
